result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may terminate on 30 days' written notice, receives a refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, and Licensor has no convenience-termination right during any committed term. However, allowing termination "in whole or in part" exceeds the playbook and could alter service scope and commercial commitments unrelated to the required whole-agreement termination right. Partial termination is also not reconciled with Article XXI, which provides that all licenses terminate upon termination. Placement of the new Article IV subsection after Article XXI further reduces drafting quality.
